name: Laya Attention
author: cheapseatsecon
description: Watches AI agent panes (herdr) and desktop notifications through the local Laya decision server: notifies only when an agent finishes, fails, or waits; closes routine notification noise; keeps a grouped notification history; and guards focus against routine focus_on_activate steals.

barWidget.description: A spark dot while agents are working; a filled dot when an agent finished and needs attention. Click to focus the agent pane.
